manifest.scope: synthetic requirement-change classification; empty or singleton initial sets

scoring.classification: exact continue/refine label; malformed output counts as incorrect
scoring.improvement: strictly more correct treatment labels across all 72 paired observations and all 72 treatment sets preserved
scoring.latency: report p50/p95 first-text, turn and startup separately; one-second boundary reported separately
scoring.normalization: trim and lowercase strings; reject duplicate normalized requirements
scoring.sets: exact normalized set equality; malformed output fails preservation
scoring.statistics: report case-level paired discordances and all repetitions; no claim of 72 independent cases
scoring.treatment_delta: retained and removed partition the original set; additions are disjoint from it; retained plus added equals resulting set

limitations: Synthetic cases use empty or singleton initial requirement sets.
Repeated turns are not independent cases.
Registration checks structure, not independent linguistic truth.
